question.:question/problem:
What are the pivot columns of the matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & -3\end{bmatrix}?
$$

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we need to convert $A$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & -3\end{bmatrix} && R_{2}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $A$ has $2$ pivots. In particular, the pivot columns are the $1$st and $2$nd columns.
